source: Examination revealed pain and deformity over right wrist, pain and bruising over right shoulder and forehead, and pain over left knee.
She was diagnosed with fracture distal radius and ulna of right wrist; and contusion of right shoulder, left knee and forehead.

Immediately after the Accident, she was admitted to the A&E of TKOH, and suffered from pain and abrasion over the left clavicle area close to the left shoulder. Bruising was found over the right eyebrow area and left leg. She was diagnosed to suffer contusion of the face, left clavicle and left leg.

manifestations.description: pain and deformity over right wrist
pain and bruising over right shoulder and forehead
easier tiredness of the hand, and needed more frequent breaks during prolonged writing and drawing
area around her right eye became swollen ("black eye") of around 3 inches in diameter which subsided after 2 to 3 weeks
felt embarrassed and distressed due to teasing by classmates
bruising over right leg, swelling over left knee, and pain over right angle of jaw, left posterior pelvis and both shoulders

treatments_received.treatment: admitted to the Accident & Emergency Department of Tseung Kwan O Hospital (TKOH) for treatment
source: Immediately after the Accident, she was admitted to the Accident & Emergency Department (“A&E”) of Tseung Kwan O Hospital (“TKOH”) for treatment.
X-rays of right forearm showed fracture of distal radius and ulna.

treatments_received.treatment: admitted to the orthopaedics ward of TKOH
source: She was admitted to the orthopaedics ward of TKOH for further management, and was put on a long arm cast for treatment of the fracture of the right wrist.

treatments_received.treatment: long arm cast for fracture of the right wrist
source: She was admitted to the orthopaedics ward of TKOH for further management, and was put on a long arm cast for treatment of the fracture of the right wrist.

treatments_received.treatment: long arm cast trimmed to a short arm cast
source: The long arm cast was trimmed to a short arm cast on 13 October 2010.
It was further removed on 3 November 2010.

treatments_received.treatment: follow-up treatments at the Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology of Prince of Wales Hospital (PWH)
source: The plaintiff was discharged from TKOH on 28 September 2010, and was referred for regular follow-up treatments at the Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology of Prince of Wales Hospital (“PWH”) on 29 September 2010.
Immediately after the Accident, she was admitted to the A&E of TKOH, and suffered from pain and abrasion over the left clavicle area close to the left shoulder.
Immediately after the Accident, she was admitted to the A&E of TKOH for treatment.
